## KSeF - Client Document Collection

**Purpose:** Collects documents from clients via webhook upload or email. Dual-path processing:
- **XML path:** Parse FA(3) KSeF XML directly, validate NIP, dedup, store
- **OCR path:** Send PDF/image to Claude Vision API, extract data, validate, match to KSeF

**Confidence threshold:** >= 0.85 = auto-process, < 0.85 = flag for manual review.

**NIP validation:** Checksum with weights [6,5,7,2,3,4,5,6,7] mod 11.

## XML Path - Direct KSeF FA(3) Parse
Parse XML invoice, validate NIP checksum, dedup, insert.

parameters.query: SELECT ksef_number FROM invoices WHERE ksef_number = '{{ $json.ksef_number }}' LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO invoices (client_nip, ksef_number, invoice_number, direction, seller_nip, seller_name, buyer_nip, buyer_name, net_amount, vat_amount, gross_amount, currency, issue_date, processing_status, raw_xml) VALUES ('{{ $('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.client_nip }}', '{{ $('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.ksef_number }}', '{{ $('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.invoice_number }}', '{{ $('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.direction }}', '{{ $('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.seller_nip }}', '{{ ($('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.seller_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ $('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.buyer_nip }}', '{{ ($('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.buyer_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', {{ $('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.net_amount || 'NULL' }}, {{ $('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.vat_amount || 'NULL' }}, {{ $('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.gross_amount || 'NULL' }}, '{{ $('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.currency }}', {{ $('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.issue_date ? "'" + $('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.issue_date + "'" : 'NULL' }}, 'new', '{{ ($('Parse FA(3) XML').first().json.raw_xml || '').substring(0, 50000).replace(/'/g, "''") }}') ON CONFLICT (ksef_number) DO NOTHING

parameters.content:
## OCR Path - PDF/Image Processing
Send to Claude Vision API for data extraction, validate, match to KSeF.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO ocr_queue (client_nip, source_type, file_path, file_type, ocr_status) VALUES ('{{ $json.client_nip }}', '{{ $json.source_type }}', '{{ $json.file_name }}', '{{ $json.file_type }}', 'processing') RETURNING id

UPDATE ocr_queue SET ocr_status = 'manual_review', confidence_score = {{ $json.confidence_score }}, extracted_data = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.extracted).replace(/'/g, "''") }}', processed_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $json.ocr_queue_id }}

SELECT ksef_number FROM invoices WHERE client_nip = '{{ $json.client_nip }}' AND seller_nip = '{{ $json.extracted.seller_nip }}' AND gross_amount = {{ $json.extracted.gross_amount || 0 }} AND issue_date = '{{ $json.extracted.issue_date }}' LIMIT 1

UPDATE ocr_queue SET ocr_status = 'completed', confidence_score = {{ $('Validate OCR Data').first().json.confidence_score }}, matched_ksef_number = '{{ $json.ksef_number || '' }}', extracted_data = '{{ JSON.stringify($('Validate OCR Data').first().json.extracted).replace(/'/g, "''") }}', processed_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $('Validate OCR Data').first().json.ocr_queue_id }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'warning', message: 'Document Collection failed: ' + ($json.message || 'Unknown error'), client_nip: 'SYSTEM', workflow_name: 'KSeF - Document Collection' }) }}
